## Description

This is a **post-closure residual defect** linked to #2751 (accepted SC-04: preserve form/dirty state on rejected writes; SC-06: Web/App edit flows). #2751's acceptance proved revision-conflict handling and App Back unsaved guard, **not Web tree selection while an edited document remains open**. Do not reopen or rewrite #2751 or its trusted acceptance history.

In current `main`:
- `web/src/app/experiences/web/FilesWebLayout.tsx`: `FileBrowser.onFileClick` unconditionally calls `setSelected({ref,...})`; `FileViewer` is keyed by `sourceId:path`, so switching paths unmounts the previous viewer without invoking `onClose`.
- `web/src/capabilities/files/hooks/useFileViewer.ts`: `content`, `originalContent` and `isDirty` are local to the mounted viewer. The unsaved-changes confirmation is only reached by `handleCloseClick`, and `FilesWebLayout` does not receive `onDirtyChange`.
- `web/src/capabilities/files/README.md` explicitly documents per-viewer state being discarded on tab switch.

## Reproduction

Open Files in Web Workspace, open text file A, click Edit, change text without saving, then click file B in the tree. The layout immediately replaces the keyed viewer. A's unsaved draft is discarded without a confirmation or a save; reopening A reloads persisted content. This is source-proven React ownership/unmount behavior; no browser execution has yet been performed.

## Impact

Silent loss of user-authored work, contradicting the 1.x promise to preserve work context across capability navigation. App pushed-detail already has a dirty leave guard; Web tree switching bypasses it.

## Fix Direction

Make Web Files switching from a dirty file a guarded navigation transition. Reuse the existing Files viewer dirty state and shared AlertDialog grammar; preserve A and its draft when the user cancels, and only switch after explicit discard or a completed save. Cover rapid repeated tree clicks and pending save, without implementing global DocumentStore, multi-tab editor, autosave, browser-wide navigation guards or a new navigation framework. Preserve current source-scoping and App behavior.

## Location

- `web/src/app/experiences/web/FilesWebLayout.tsx`
- `web/src/capabilities/files/hooks/useFileViewer.ts`
- `web/src/capabilities/files/README.md`

## Root Cause

`FilesWebLayout` unconditionally replaces the keyed `FileViewer` on tree selection, bypassing the existing dirty-state confirmation. `useFileViewer` state is local to the mounted viewer instance, and `FilesWebLayout` does not receive `onDirtyChange`, so the unsaved-changes guard is never reached during tree navigation.

## Success Criteria

- [ ] SC-01 On Web, editing A then selecting B presents a single unsaved-change decision; Cancel keeps A's exact draft and current selection; explicit Discard opens B. A clean A switches directly.
- [ ] SC-02 While save is pending or fails, switching cannot silently discard A; a successful guarded save can proceed to B without dropping the committed edit. Repeated B/C selection cannot bypass the guard or open the wrong target.

**SC → scenario:** SC-01/SC-02: SCN-02 Web/App interaction, Chromium + Playwright browser Case at desktop viewport, using deterministic mutable FileOps fixture, real click/edit/save-failure interactions and DOM/content assertions. Earliest valid proof: PR head, `method: case`; use existing approved browser Case infrastructure (`files-context-create` as the regression starting point). No external provider credentials or privileged runner required. Assert persisted fixture A and displayed draft separately; capture trace on failure.

## Prototype

**Decision: Not needed.** This is a narrowly defined correction to an existing Web file-switch interaction, reusing the established unsaved-changes dialog and Files pattern. Existing #2751 prototype is historical, not proof of production behavior; no new visual paradigm or responsive choice is introduced.

- Related knowledge: Existing Files ownership README and #2751 FileWorkspace pattern
- Reason: This restores the existing dirty-edit navigation invariant without changing the product model.
- Owner and timing: Files implementer confirms no knowledge contract change during PR review.
- Evidence: Current main source paths and linked #2751 acceptance.
